tool_description: Real-time log file monitoring. Auto-discovers .log files under C:/Users/beren and also includes C:/Users/beren/Anna_AI/startup_log.txt. Watches logs for errors, exceptions, crashes, log spam and fast growth. Alerts injected into thought buffer proactively.

available_commands.description: Start watching a specific log file
List all watched log files with error counts
Get the last N lines from a log file
Search a log file for a keyword
Auto-discover and watch all .log files under C:/Users/beren

tool_usage_guidance: Auto-discovers all .log files on startup and adds startup_log.txt if present
Polls every 5 seconds for new log content
Detects: ERROR/EXCEPTION keywords, crash patterns, log spam (20+ repeats in 60s), fast growth (10MB/min)
Use get_tail to read recent log output
Use search_log to find specific errors or events
Use list_watched to see all monitored files and their error counts
proactive_triggers: When an error or exception appears in any watched log file
When a crash pattern is detected (exit code, killed by signal)
When the same log line repeats 20+ times in 60 seconds
When a log file grows faster than 10MB per minute
When user asks 'check my logs' or 'any errors in the logs?'

metadata.notes: Auto-discovers logs on startup. Background context loop polls all watched files every 5 seconds.
